issues.sentence: If you are building an Indic voice or support agent, this is now the cheapest serious Indian option to test.
issues.problem: Superlative unsupported: the Sarvam post compares price only against Gemini, GPT-6 Luna, Gemma and other non-Indian Flash-Lite models, never against other Indian options.
issues.replacement: If you are building an Indic voice or support agent, it is worth testing at that price.

issues.sentence: Data pipelines for physical AI are a real business in India now, and a hiring one.
issues.problem: TechCrunch gives 51 full-time employees but says nothing about hiring.
issues.replacement: Data pipelines for physical AI are a real business in India now.

issues.sentence: The bottleneck CtrlS names is power, not chips.
issues.problem: AIM reports power forecasting and approvals as the challenge but never contrasts power with chips; 'not chips' is added.
issues.replacement: The bottleneck CtrlS names is power.

issues.sentence: The biggest India AI cheque of the week went to data, not models.
issues.problem: Wrong superlative: the same draft (StartupTalky, line 56) has Dreamteam raising $53 million, more than Humyn Labs' $47 million.
